data.body: RP-06 D6.1 approved: Option B is the final runtime failure policy. After RP-01 exhausts a criterion-local operation, preserve all completed successful results, continue independent units, skip dependency-blocked units with provenance, and record the failed unit as a coverage gap. A blocking-capable missing unit yields unsigned INDETERMINATE unless an actual blocking finding takes precedence as BLOCK; advisory-only gaps may still PASS. Systemic/configuration/cancellation/DET behavior remains unchanged. No failed unit retries again in the same invocation. Explicit `review-plan --retry` later resumes only missing content-identical calls and authorizes a fresh attempt budget. Option A remains only for shadow trace comparison and rollback during expand/contract, not as production behavior. Updated local authorities: `.joe-janitor/rp06-option-b-impact.md`, `rp06-chronology-failure-critique.md`, and `rp06-review-kernel-research.md`.
